contract.content_scope: PI_live and PI_silent only; all eligible pairs and both transplant directions
contract.deletion_scope: all four conditions, all official worlds, same endpoint parameters
identity_checks: listener PI input and own W1 equal
transplanted inputs exactly equal donor inputs
regenerated own W2 exactly equals donor own W2
contract.independent_units: four paired training initializations; states, actors, directions and pairs are repeated measurements
contract.limits: endpoint route/content interventions are local-policy dependence; PI training contrast is total learning effect; neither proves compositionality nor successful new team policy
contract.pair_rule: same partition, needs, owners, public material, listener private material; other private sites swapped; disjoint R1 action projections

probability_roundoff.scope: saved endpoint vs recomputation only; exact routed inputs, tokens, argmax and same-batch donor probabilities are never relaxed

contract.silent_invariants: both deletion variants unchanged; same-observation pair has same natural action and cannot be suitable at both endpoints
contract.transplant: replace other people in both received windows; preserve own W1; regenerate own W2 after donor W1; action sees donor other W2 and regenerated own W2

result_hashes: bound and saved after all runs complete, before loading any checkpoint
